the implementation of measures aimed at improving energy efficiency and reducing emissions of pollutants in the household sector, which are the subject of this study, will reduce energy consumption and emissions in the household sector in the long term.

the measures taken by the government to reduce low stack emissions from households have a positive impact on the improvement of the energy efficiency and the reduction of pollutants emission from households in Poland, and the impact on the improvement in energy efficiency and the decrease in pollutant emissions is higher for the replacement of the boiler than for the change of fuel type and the thermal insulation of buildings.
the measures to reduce the low stack emission from households have a positive impact on energy efficiency and reduce the emission of pollutants.

the impact of the implementation of the following measures on the improvement of household energy efficiency and emission reduction: replacement of old inefficient heating boiler, replacement of old inefficient boiler with a modern boiler with a condensation heat exchanger, replacement of old boiler with a modern condensing gas boiler, replacement of an old boiler with a new gas boiler, replacement an old inefficient boiler with an efficient pellet boiler, replacement of a coal boiler with a gas boiler, replacement a coal boiler with pellet boiler, replacement a wood boiler
the impact of measures taken to reduce low stack emissions on energy efficiency and the emissions of pollutants from the domestic sector in Poland.
the evaluation of the impact of measures taken to reduce low stack emissions in Poland on energy efficiency and the household emission of pollutants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the measures aimed at reducing the emission of pollutants in the household sector in the form of the replacement of heating boilers and the change of the type of fuel used in the household sector have a positive impact on the reduction of the emission of pollutants, but at the same time have a negative impact on energy consumption and the emission of greenhouse gases (GHG).

the implementation of the remedial actions considered in the study will result in a reduction in the emission of pollutants, and in the case of the boiler replacement and change of fuel type - in an improvement of energy efficiency.

the implementation of remedial actions aimed at reducing low-stack emissions from the household heating sector in Poland, which are a consequence of environmental regulations, will have a positive effect on the improvement of the energy efficiency and reduction of emissions of pollutants from the sector.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the measures aimed at reducing emissions from the household heating sector have a positive impact on energy efficiency and the level of emissions of pollutants.
the measures taken to reduce low stack emissions have a significant impact on the reduction of the emission of pollutants and the improvement of energy performance of households in Poland.
in order to reduce low stack emission in the household sector, the most important is to replace old inefficient boilers, especially those that are not equipped with a filter.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the implementation of remedial actions aimed at reducing low-stack emissions from households, as a result of the environmental regulations, will have a significant positive effect on the energy efficiency of households and on the emission of pollutants.

a significant reduction in emissions of pollutants from the residential sector is possible by replacing the existing heating system with an energy-efficient one and by using modern fuels, which will reduce energy consumption and improve the quality of the air in Polish cities and villages.

the implementation of measures aimed at the improvement of the energy efficiency of the household sector in order to reduce the emission of pollutants has a positive impact on the improvement of the household sector’s energy efficiency.
